title: MIDNIGHT HEIST
subtitle: A museum at midnight. Ten stolen bones. One dinosaur waiting to stand.
lostLoot: The loot in your bag is lost.
tutorialMove: Move quietly through the museum. The bone is marked in gold.
tutorialSteal: Hold E near a glowing fossil to collect it.
tutorialHide: Hide when the guard investigates the sound.
tutorialExit: Carry the bone to the green exit.
introSubtitle: Take the fossils and the dinosaur bone. Escape before dawn.
guardWatching: The guard is watching â€” hide first!
tutorialBone: The gold-marked bone is mandatory. Find it before you leave.
newCampaignConfirm: Start a new campaign? The ten bones and the field book will be cleared. Money, upgrades and fossils stay.
museumSub: Study what you stole, mount the bones, and write it all down before you forget.
boneHallSub: Ten pieces, one animal. Each night adds one bone to the stand.
fossilCabinetSub: Fossils are kept apart from the skeleton, each on its own shelf.
labDone: Nothing left on the table. The book is up to date.
labPending: {n} specimens are waiting on the table.
bookAuthor: written by the assistant, one night at a time
bookIntro: Every specimen gets a page: what it is, where it came from, and what it tells us.
bookEmpty: The first page is still blank.
studyFirst: Study every specimen from tonight before the next night.
notStudiedYet: Not studied yet. Take it to the lab.
cleanHint: Brush the matrix away in slow strokes. This bone survived sixty-six million years; it can survive one more night.
fossilRecovered: A display case in the museum
analyzeHint: Every measurement is written down before anything is mounted.
finaleBody: Ten nights, ten bones, one book. The hall is quiet now, but the dinosaur no longer lies in pieces: the assistant notes and your thefts have put it back on its feet. Tomorrow the museum opens with a new name on the plaque.
mountHint: Click a glowing slot to mount its bone on the skeleton.
